scripts.dev: pnpm run build:shared && pnpm --parallel --filter "./apps/*" run dev
scripts.dev:api: pnpm run build:shared && pnpm --filter "./apps/api" run dev
scripts.dev:web: pnpm run build:shared && pnpm --filter "./apps/web" run dev
scripts.test: pnpm run build:shared && pnpm -r --if-present run test
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run build:shared && pnpm -r --if-present run typecheck
